label: General legal notice (demand or warning)

review.note: Fixed wording is a standard notice format. It has not yet been reviewed by a practising advocate.

notes: Some claims need a statutory notice period or a specific form (for example a notice to the Government under Section 80 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, or a notice under Section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882). Check that a general notice is enough for your claim.

slots.label: Your name, as the advocate issuing the notice
Name of the person receiving the notice
Subject of the notice, in a few words
slots.example: non-delivery of flat as per agreement dated 3 January 2024

slots.label: What happened? Write one fact per line, in date order
slots.example:
That my client booked flat no. B-204 under agreement dated 3 January 2024.
That possession was due on 30 June 2025 and has not been given.

slots.label: What do you want the recipient to do?
slots.example: hand over possession of flat no. B-204 and pay the agreed delay compensation

slots.label: Number of days you are allowing
What will your client do if the recipient does not comply?
slots.example: my client shall be constrained to approach the appropriate court

slots.label: How the notice will be sent

blocks.text: Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, {{sender_name}}, {{sender_address}} ("my client"), I serve upon you the following notice:
That my client hereby calls upon you to {{demand}} within {{days}} days of receipt of this notice, failing which {{consequence}}, at your risk as to costs and consequences.
That this notice is issued without prejudice to all other rights and remedies available to my client, all of which are reserved.
